natives.definitionKo: 일정한 곳에 머물러 살고 있는 주민.
natives.englishDescription: People living in a certain place.

naturalness.definitionKo: 사람의 힘을 보태지 않은 자연 그대로의 상태.
naturalness.englishDescription: The natural state of something without artificiality.

noraebang.definitionKo: 가사를 보면서 노래를 부를 수 있도록 음악 기계를 갖추어 놓은 장소.
noraebang.englishDescription: A place furnished with a karaoke machine so that people can sing to lyrics.

norigae.definitionKo: 여자 한복 저고리의 고름이나 치마의 맨 윗부분 등에 다는 장신구.
norigae.englishDescription: An accessory hung to the goreum, strips, of a jeogori, a traditional Korean upper garment, or the top of the traditional Korean skirt.

notebook.definitionKo: 글씨를 쓰거나 그림을 그릴 수 있도록 줄이 쳐져 있거나 빈 종이로 매어 놓은 책.
notebook.englishDescription: A book of blank or lined paper to write or draw on.

notebook.definitionKo: 글씨를 쓰거나 그림을 그릴 수 있게 흰 종이나 줄을 친 종이를 묶은 책.
notebook.englishDescription: A book made by binding pieces of white or lined paper for writing or drawing pictures.

nursing.englishDescription: Caring for and looking after sick people.
An act of caring for a sick person at his/her side.

nursing.definitionKo: 학교 등의 시설에서 사람들의 건강과 위생을 살피고 돌봄.
nursing.englishDescription: An act of taking care of people's health and hygiene in a certain facility such as schools.

nursing.definitionKo: 아픈 사람이나 아이를 낳은 사람을 간호함.
nursing.englishDescription: Taking care of a patient or a person who has just had a baby.
The act of looking after the sick or injured.
The act of tending and caring for a sick person.
The act of breast-feeding a baby.

obedience.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 명령이나 의견에 그대로 따름.
obedience.englishDescription: The act of following someone's order or opinion without hesitation.

obedience.definitionKo: 운명이나 다른 사람의 말 등에 순순히 따름.
obedience.englishDescription: Obediently following fate or the words of others.

obese.englishDescription: One's body being big and fat.

objection.definitionKo: 윗사람의 뜻이나 명령 등을 따르지 않고 거스름.
objection.englishDescription: An act of refusing to obey and acting against the will or command of a superior.

objection.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 주장이나 의견에 반대하여 말함. 또는 그런 주장.
objection.englishDescription: The act of saying something against someone's argument or opinion, or such an argument.

objection.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이나 의견 등을 따르지 않고 거스름.
objection.englishDescription: The state of being against a certain behavior, opinion, etc., without following it.

objection.definitionKo: 어떤 주장이나 결정 등에 대해 가지는 다른 의견.
objection.englishDescription: A different opinion held by one against a certain argument, decision, etc.

observation.definitionKo: 사람을 단속하거나 상황을 통제하기 위해 주의 깊게 지켜봄.
observation.englishDescription: An act of monitoring closely to control a person or situation.

observation.definitionKo: 사물이나 현상을 주의 깊게 자세히 살펴봄.
observation.englishDescription: The act of watching an object or phenomenon carefully and in detail.

observation.definitionKo: 눈이나 기계로 자연 현상을 자세히 살펴보아 어떤 사실을 짐작하거나 알아냄.
observation.englishDescription: An act of guessing or finding out a fact of natural phenomena by using a machine or observing in detail with eyes.

observation.definitionKo: 형편이나 분위기 등에 간섭하지 않고 멀리서 보기만 함.
observation.englishDescription: An act of just seeing from a distance, not intervening in the situation or circumstances.
An act of seeing a landscape or other things from a distance.

observation.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 벌어지는 장소에 가서 그 일을 직접 봄.
observation.englishDescription: An act of going to an event and watching it.

observer.definitionKo: 사물이나 현상을 주의 깊게 자세히 살펴보는 사람.
observer.englishDescription: A person who observes an object or phenomenon in detail.

observer.definitionKo: 나중에 증인으로 삼을 수 있도록, 어떤 일이 벌어지는 현장에 함께 참석하여 지켜보게 하는 사람.
observer.englishDescription: A person asked or allowed to attend and observe something on site, as a potential witness.

observer.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 벌어지는 장소에 가서 그 일을 직접 보는 사람.
observer.englishDescription: A person who goes to an event and watches it.

officiating.definitionKo: 결혼식 등에서 식을 맡아 진행하는 일.
officiating.englishDescription: The act of presiding over a ceremony such as a wedding.

operator.definitionKo: 기계나 자동차 등의 운전을 직업으로 하는 사람.
operator.englishDescription: A person whose occupation is to operate a machine or car, etc.

operator.definitionKo: 조직이나 기구, 사업체 등을 관리하고 이끌어 나가는 사람.
operator.englishDescription: A person who manages and leads an organization, organization, business, etc.

operator.definitionKo: 어떤 문제에 대해 듣고 도움말을 해 주는 것이 직업인 사람.
operator.englishDescription: A person whose job it is to listen to someone's matter and give him/her advice.

operator.definitionKo: 기계나 기구 등을 다루어 움직이게 하는 사람.
operator.englishDescription: A person who handles a machine, device, etc., to make it move.
One who works at a factory.

overambitious.definitionKo: 엉뚱한 욕심을 품고 깜찍하게 분수에 넘치는 짓을 하려는 태도가 있다.
overambitious.englishDescription: Trying to do something out of absurd greed.

overambitious.definitionKo: 엉뚱한 욕심을 품고 분수에 넘치는 짓을 하려는 태도가 있다.
overambitious.englishDescription: Trying to do something cleverly with absurd greed.

overcome.definitionKo: 상대나 상황을 감당하거나 맞서서 이겨 내다.
overcome.englishDescription: To deal with or fight back against an opponent or situation and overcome it.
To get over a difficult situation.

overcome.definitionKo: 극복하거나 이기기 어려운 것을 넘거나 이겨 내다.
overcome.englishDescription: To overcome or get over something that is difficult to conquer or win.

overcome.definitionKo: 어려운 일이나 기록 등이 극복되거나 돌파되다.
overcome.englishDescription: To overcome or break through a challenge, record, etc.

overcome.definitionKo: 나쁜 조건이나 힘든 일 등을 이겨 내다.
overcome.englishDescription: To get over a bad condition, difficult situation, etc.

overcome.definitionKo: 극복하거나 이기기 어려운 것을 넘거나 이겨 내다.
overcome.englishDescription: To overcome or get over something that is difficult to conquer or win.
To overcome a difficulty or danger.

overcome.definitionKo: 장애물이나 어려운 고비 등을 뚫고 지나가다.
overcome.englishDescription: To overcome an obstacle, difficulty, etc.
To get over a difficult situation.
To get over and eliminate something.
To fight and get over with a difficulty.
To suppress a feeling, desire, etc.

overcome.definitionKo: 어려운 일을 잘 처리하여 해결의 길을 열다.
overcome.englishDescription: To resolve a difficult problem and find a solution.
To get over a difficulty and move forward.

overdose.definitionKo: 약이나 음식 등을 지나치게 많이 먹거나 돈을 지나치게 많이 쓰다.
overdose.englishDescription: To eat too much food, take too much medicine or spend too much money.

overrule.definitionKo: 기존의 체제, 제도, 학설 등을 뒤엎다.
overrule.englishDescription: To turn over an existing regime, system, theory, etc.
To reverse or change an argument, opinion, etc.

oversensitiveness.definitionKo: 신체 감각이나 감정, 기분 등이 지나치게 예민한 성질이나 특성.
oversensitiveness.englishDescription: The quality or feature of oversensitive senses, feelings, or moods, etc.

particularization.definitionKo: 보통과 매우 차이가 나게 다르게 됨. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
particularization.englishDescription: The state of becoming very different from what is normal, or an act of changing something that way.

passivity.definitionKo: 스스로 움직이지 않고 남의 힘을 받아 움직임.
passivity.englishDescription: The quality of being acted upon not by oneself but by an external force.
A quality that belongs to the negative and passive sound.

patronize.definitionKo: 물건이나 장소 등을 좋아하여 자주 사용하다.
patronize.englishDescription: To love a certain object or place and therefore use it frequently.

phased.englishDescription: Following the order or process of work.

pick.englishDescription: To remove or pull hair, grass, etc.
To decide by choosing one among many.

pick.definitionKo: 어딘가에 박혀 있는 것을 잡아당기어 나오게 하다.
pick.englishDescription: To pull at a thing stuck somewhere so as to make it come out.

pick.definitionKo: 붙어 있는 것을 떨어지게 하거나 떼어 내다.
pick.englishDescription: To tear apart or make something torn that was previously attached.

pick.definitionKo: 달려 있거나 붙어 있는 것을 잡아서 뜯거나 떼다.
pick.englishDescription: To take or tear off something clinging or attached to something.
To point at a specific object or person.

pick.definitionKo: 꼬챙이나 막대기 등으로 마구 찌르거나 후비다.
pick.englishDescription: To pierce or dig up something with a stick, skewer, etc.
To scrape off or scoop up something from a hole or crack.

pick.definitionKo: 속에 든 것이 겉으로 드러나도록 덮인 부분을 파거나 젖히다.
pick.englishDescription: To dig or open something to outwardly reveal things inside.

pick.definitionKo: 손톱이나 날카로운 물건으로 계속 긁어 파거나 젖히다.
pick.englishDescription: To dig or open something, scratching it repeatedly with nails or a sharp object.

pipeline.englishDescription: A pipe that sends gas, liquid, etc.

pleasedly.englishDescription: In the state of being very happy and pleased with something.

plumply.englishDescription: In a manner of being small and plump.

plumply.definitionKo: 보기 좋을 정도로 살이 통통하게 찐 모양.
plumply.englishDescription: A word describing one's appearance being a little roundish, in a nice way.

plumply.definitionKo: 보기에 좋지 않을 정도로 살이 쪄서 퉁퉁한 모양.
plumply.englishDescription: A word describing someone gaining weight and looking unattractively fat.

portugal.definitionKo: 유럽 남부 이베리아반도의 서쪽 끝에 있는 나라. 주요 생산물로는 포도, 올리브 등이 있다. 주요 언어는 포르투갈어이고 수도는 리스본이다.
portugal.englishDescription: A country at the western end of the Iberian Peninsula of southern Europe; it is a major producer of grapes, olives, etc.; its major language is Portuguese; its capital is Lisbon.

potent.englishDescription: The taste, smell, etc., being too strong.

potent.definitionKo: 맛이나 냄새 등이 해롭거나 참기 어려울 정도로 심한 데가 있다.
potent.englishDescription: Having an intolerably harmful or strong taste, smell, etc.

potent.definitionKo: 맛이나 냄새 등이 해롭거나 참기 어려울 정도로 심하다.
potent.englishDescription: Having an intolerably harmful or strong taste, smell, etc.

productivity.definitionKo: 생산하는 데 들어간 비용과 그에 따른 생산량의 비율.
productivity.englishDescription: The ratio of output to its production cost.

program.englishDescription: The act of thinking in detail about future events and make arrangements for them.

program.definitionKo: 악곡이나 노래의 제목을 적어 놓은 목록.
program.englishDescription: The list of titles for songs or pieces of music.
The process or procedure of education or training.

program.definitionKo: 신문이나 방송에서 일정한 것을 다루는 지면이나 프로그램.
program.englishDescription: A designated page of a newspaper or a designated program of broadcasting, that deals with a regular topic.

program.definitionKo: 일정한 기간 동안 해야 할 일. 또는 그 일을 하기 위해 짜 놓은 계획.
program.englishDescription: Things that have to be done for a certain period of time; a plan made to do such things.

program.definitionKo: 라디오나 텔레비전 등에서 시간별로 나뉘어 방송되는 내용. 또는 그 차례나 목록.
program.englishDescription: The content that is broadcast on a radio or television by time, or the order or list of it.
The order that a ceremony is held in.

protestantism.definitionKo: 종교 개혁에 의해 가톨릭에서 갈라져 나온 기독교의 한 교파.
protestantism.englishDescription: A Christian sect that branched out from the Catholic church due to the Reformation.

protestantism.definitionKo: 종교 개혁에 의해 가톨릭에서 갈라져 나온 기독교의 한 교파.
protestantism.englishDescription: A sect of Christianity that branched off from Catholicism due to the Reformation.

psychology.definitionKo: 사람과 동물의 마음의 상태나 행동을 연구하는 학문.
psychology.englishDescription: The science that studies the mental state or behavior of people or animals.

psychology.definitionKo: 인간이나 동물의 의식과 행동을 연구하는 학문.
psychology.englishDescription: A science studying the consciousness and behaviors of people or animals.

punctually.definitionKo: 규칙이나 차례 등을 한 번도 어기지 않고 지키는 모양.
punctually.englishDescription: In the manner of following a rule, order, etc., without violating it.
In a way that one does not break a promise, etc.

puncture.definitionKo: 한쪽에서 다른 한쪽으로 뚫어서 구멍이 남.
puncture.englishDescription: A state in which a hole is made by piercing something from one side to the other.

puncture.definitionKo: 고무 튜브 등에 구멍이 나서 터지는 일. 또는 그 구멍.
puncture.englishDescription: The state of a rubber tube, etc., having a hole and bursting, or such a hole.

purify.englishDescription: To make someone or something pure by eliminating impurities.

purify.definitionKo: 사람을 가르쳐 생각이나 감정을 바람직하게 변하게 하다.
purify.englishDescription: To cause someone to change his/her thoughts or feelings in a desirable manner by teaching him/her.
To make someone or something pure by eliminating impurities.
(figurative) To eliminate elements that are usually negative.

purify.definitionKo: 더러운 것이나 순수하지 않은 것을 깨끗하게 하다.
purify.englishDescription: To make clean something dirty or impure.

purify.definitionKo: 마음속의 우울, 불안, 긴장 등을 해소하고 마음을 깨끗하게 하다.
purify.englishDescription: To rid one's mind of depression, anxiety, nervousness, etc., and keep it clean.

purify.definitionKo: 더러운 것이나 순수하지 않은 것을 깨끗하게 하다.
purify.englishDescription: To make clean something dirty or impure.

purify.definitionKo: 마음속의 우울, 불안, 긴장 등을 해소하고 마음을 깨끗하게 하다.
purify.englishDescription: To rid one's mind of depression, anxiety, nervousness, etc., and keep it clean.
(figurative) To eliminate elements that are usually negative.

pyebaek.definitionKo: 결혼할 때 신부가 처음으로 시부모에게 큰절을 하고 올리는, 대추와 포 등의 음식.
pyebaek.englishDescription: pyebaek food; food at formal greeting by newlyweds: In a wedding ceremony, food such as jujubes, beef jerky, etc., which is offered when the bride bows to her parents-in-laws for the first time.

pyebaek.definitionKo: 결혼할 때 신부가 시부모와 시댁 친척 어른들에게 절을 하는 일.
pyebaek.englishDescription: formal greeting by newlyweds: In a wedding ceremony, the act of a bride bowing deeply to her parents-in-laws and new relatives.

pyebaek.definitionKo: 혼인 전에 신랑이 신부 집에 보내는 물건.
pyebaek.englishDescription: gift to a bride-to-be: An object sent from a groom to his bride’s house.

quote.definitionKo: 어떤 형식이나 이론 또는 다른 사람의 말이나 글을 따르다.
quote.englishDescription: To use a certain form, theory, or someone's writing or speaking.

quote.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 말이나 글, 어떤 사실을 자기 것에 가져다 쓰다.
quote.englishDescription: To cite someone else's words, writing, or certain facts in one's own.
To quote a price or value.

quote.definitionKo: 말이나 글 등에서 한 부분을 끌어다 쓰다.
quote.englishDescription: To take and use a part from words or writing.
A sentence quoted from another person's speech or text.

quote.definitionKo: 남의 말이나 글을 자신의 말이나 글 속에 끌어 쓰다.
quote.englishDescription: To repeat another person's remark or text in one's own speech or writing.

quote.definitionKo: 남의 말이나 글 가운데서 필요한 부분을 끌어오다.
quote.englishDescription: To take a necessary part from someone's speech or piece of writing.

re-examination.definitionKo: 지난 일이나 사물을 그 가치가 드러나도록 다시 자세히 살펴봄.
re-examination.englishDescription: The act of looking into a matter or thing from the past closely again to reveal its value.

rearrange.definitionKo: 한 번 정리하였던 것을 다시 바르게 고치다.
rearrange.englishDescription: To further organize what has already been organized.

rearrange.definitionKo: 어떤 기준이나 상황에 알맞게 다시 고치다.
rearrange.englishDescription: To change something again to comply with a standard or make it fit a given situation.

rebuttal.definitionKo: 어떤 의견이나 주장 등에 반대하여 말함.
rebuttal.englishDescription: The act of saying something against a certain opinion, argument, etc.

rebuttal.definitionKo: 어떤 의견이나 주장 등에 반대하는 내용을 적은 글.
rebuttal.englishDescription: A statement of refuting or rebutting a certain opinion, argument, etc.

rebuttal.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 주장에 맞서 옳고 그름을 따짐.
rebuttal.englishDescription: An act of arguing over what is right and wrong against another's opinion.

refrain.englishDescription: The part repeated in a song.

refrain.definitionKo: 시에서, 각 절의 끝에 되풀이되는 같은 시구.
refrain.englishDescription: In a poem, a line that repeats at the end of each verse.

refrain.definitionKo: 노래의 끝에 같은 가락으로 되풀이하여 부르는 짧은 몇 마디의 가사.
refrain.englishDescription: A short, few bars in lyrics, which are sung repeatedly to the same melody at the end of the song.

reject.englishDescription: To turn down a petition or an application because of a law.
Not to accept a demand, suggestion, etc.

reject.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 부탁이나 제안, 선물 등을 받아들이지 않다.
reject.englishDescription: Not to accept a request, proposal or gift from another person.

reject.definitionKo: 법원이 법적으로 내어진 문제나 안건 등을 이유가 없다고 판단하여 받아들이지 않기로 결정하다.
reject.englishDescription: For the court to judge that a case has no legal grounds and decide to dismiss it.

reject.definitionKo: 시험이나 선발 등에 붙거나 뽑히지 못하게 하다.
reject.englishDescription: To make someone fail to pass an examination or be picked in a selection.
To decline and not take an offer.

reject.definitionKo: 어떤 사상이나 의견, 태도, 물건 등을 받아들이지 않다.
reject.englishDescription: To reject a certain idea, opinion, attitude, object, etc.

reject.definitionKo: 싫어하여 끼워 주지 않거나 따돌려 밀어내다.
reject.englishDescription: To exclude or shut out a person or thing out of hatred.

reject.definitionKo: 회의에서 의논한 안건을 반대하여 받아들이지 않기로 결정하다.
reject.englishDescription: To decide to oppose and reject an agenda discussed in a meeting.

reject.definitionKo: 시험이나 선발 등에 붙거나 뽑히지 못하게 하다.
reject.englishDescription: To make someone fail to pass an examination or be picked in a selection.
To turn down an offer, a request, etc.

reject.definitionKo: 제안이나 부탁 등을 한 번에 거절하여 받아들이지 않다.
reject.englishDescription: To reject a proposal, request, etc., flatly and not accept it.

reject.definitionKo: 소문이나 의혹, 주장 등을 강하게 부인하거나 더 이상 말하지 않다.
reject.englishDescription: To deny a rumor, suspicion, claim, etc., strongly or not talk about it anymore.

reject.definitionKo: 더 발전된 단계로 나아가기 위하여 어떤 것을 하지 않다.
reject.englishDescription: To not do something to achieve greater development.

reject.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 요구나 의견 등을 거절하다.
reject.englishDescription: To decline someone’s demand, opinion, etc.

reject.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 요구나 의견 등을 거절하다.
reject.englishDescription: To not accept someone’s demand, opinion, etc.

relate.definitionKo: 둘 이상의 사람, 사물, 현상 등이 서로 영향을 주고받도록 관계를 맺게 하다.
relate.englishDescription: To make two or more people, objects, phenomena, etc., related so that they can affect each other.

relate.englishDescription: To make two or more people, objects, phenomena, etc., related with each other.

relate.definitionKo: 어떤 사물이나 현상을 다른 것과 서로 관련시키다.
relate.englishDescription: To relate an object or phenomenon to another.

relate.definitionKo: 어떤 사물이나 현상을 다른 것과 서로 관련시키다.
relate.englishDescription: To relate an object or phenomenon to another.
To tell one's thoughts or feelings to a superior.

relate.definitionKo: 둘 이상의 사물이나 현상 등이 서로 관계를 맺다.
relate.englishDescription: To connect or relate two or more things or phenomena, etc., to each other.

relate.definitionKo: 둘 이상의 사물이나 현상 등이 서로 관계를 맺게 하다.
relate.englishDescription: To connect or relate two or more things or phenomena, etc., to each other.

reliant.definitionKo: 자신의 힘으로 하지 못하고 무엇에 기대는 성질이 있는.
reliant.englishDescription: Tending to depend on something, not being able to handle a certain thing on one's own.

resounding.definitionKo: 옥이 서로 부딪쳐 울리는 소리가 맑다.
resounding.englishDescription: The clear, resounding sound produced when jade stones are struck against each other.

resounding.definitionKo: 전에 들었던 말이나 소리가 귀에 울리는 듯하다.
resounding.englishDescription: Feeling as if words or sound one heard in the past resounds in one's ear.

rhythmic.definitionKo: 사람이나 물체의 움직임이 일정한 사이를 두고 조화롭게 규칙적으로 되풀이되는.
rhythmic.englishDescription: The movement of someone or something being regularly repeated in harmony.

ribbon.definitionKo: 머리, 모자, 선물 등을 장식할 때 쓰는 끈이나 띠.
ribbon.englishDescription: A string or band used for decorating one's hair, a hat, a present, etc.

ribbon.definitionKo: 타자기나 프린터 등에 쓰이는, 잉크를 발라서 인쇄를 할 수 있도록 만든 띠.
ribbon.englishDescription: A strip used in a typewriter or printer, etc., designed to apply ink and print.

ribbon.definitionKo: 리듬 체조에서 쓰는 기구로서 손잡이가 달려 있는 긴 띠.
ribbon.englishDescription: A long band with a handle, used as an instrument in rhythmic gymnastics.

riddle.definitionKo: 어떤 사물에 대해 다른 사물을 빗대어서 말하여 그 뜻이나 이름을 알아맞히는 놀이.
riddle.englishDescription: A game where one figures out the name of a certain object or its meaning when someone else describes it without naming it.

riddle.definitionKo: 어떤 사물이나 현상이 복잡하고 이상하게 얽혀서 그 속사정을 쉽게 알 수 없는 것.
riddle.englishDescription: A state in which a certain object or phenomenon is too complicated and puzzling to understand fully.

rwanda.definitionKo: 아프리카 동남부에 있는 나라. 농업이 발달했고, 주요 생산물로는 커피, 차 등이 있다. 공용어는 킨야르완다어, 프랑스어, 영어이고 수도는 키갈리이다.
rwanda.englishDescription: A country located in southeastern Africa, where agriculture is well-developed; it is a major producer of coffee, tea, etc.; its official languages are Kinyarwanda, French, and English, and its capital is Kigali.

salvation.definitionKo: 기독교에서, 인간을 죄악과 죽음에서 구하는 일.
salvation.englishDescription: In Christianity, the act of saving people from their sins and death.

sealing.definitionKo: 서류나 물건을 검사한 표시로 도장을 찍는 일. 또는 그 도장.
sealing.englishDescription: Impressing a seal or stamp as a mark of inspection of documents or objects, or the seal or stamp used in that action.

sealing.definitionKo: 빠져나갈 틈이 없이 꼭 막거나 닫음.
sealing.englishDescription: The act of closing up or stopping something so that nothing leaks.

sealing.definitionKo: 내용물이 밖으로 나오거나 안에 다른 것이 들어갈 수 없도록 틈을 막아 단단히 붙임.
sealing.englishDescription: The act of stopping something up to prevent its contents from getting out or external things from getting in.

sealing.definitionKo: 봉투나 상자 등을 열지 못하게 단단히 붙이고 그 자리에 도장을 찍음. 또는 그렇게 찍힌 도장.
sealing.englishDescription: The act of gluing or taping up an envelope or box and affixing a seal across the flap or seam; the affixed seal.

sealing.definitionKo: 봉투 등에 내용물을 넣고 열리지 않게 단단히 붙임.
sealing.englishDescription: The act of gluing an envelope shut, etc., so that it cannot be opened.

seethingly.definitionKo: 많은 양의 액체나 큰 거품이 자꾸 끓거나 일어나는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
seethingly.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of a large amount of liquid boiling or big bubbles appearing.

self-possession.definitionKo: 당연히 머뭇거리거나 두려워할 상황에서 태도나 얼굴빛이 아무렇지도 않음.
self-possession.englishDescription: The state of showing no difference in attitude or complexion, in a situation in which one is expected to hesitate or be scared.

selfish.englishDescription: Thinking only of one's own interests.
Dealing with something after pondering on whether it serves one's own interest.

sensor.definitionKo: 소리, 빛, 온도 등의 발생이나 변화를 알아내는 기계 장치.
sensor.englishDescription: A machine which detects occurrences or changes in sound, light, and temperature.

sensor.definitionKo: 소리, 빛, 온도 등의 발생이나 변화를 알아내는 기계 장치.
sensor.englishDescription: A machine that detects an occurrence or change of sound, light, temperature, etc.

seriousness.englishDescription: A compound noun meaning significance and insignificance.
The nature of something being very deep, important, and desperate.

shoot-out.englishDescription: A fight in which people shoot guns.

shove.definitionKo: 물체 등을 힘껏 힘을 주어 앞으로 나아가게 하다.
shove.englishDescription: To push an object, etc., in full strength and make it advance.

shove.definitionKo: 물체 등을 힘껏 힘을 주어 앞으로 나아가게 하다.
shove.englishDescription: To make something move forward by applying power to it.
To grab something and force it into something else.
To put something away roughly and carelessly.
To put something away roughly and carelessly.

shove.definitionKo: 함부로 마구 쑤셔 넣거나 밀어 넣다.
shove.englishDescription: To put or push something in roughly and carelessly.

siblings.englishDescription: Children born to or raised by the same parents.

sifter.definitionKo: 가루를 곱게 만들거나 액체에서 찌꺼기를 거르는 데 쓰는 도구.
sifter.englishDescription: A tool for filtering powder or liquid finely by separating lumps or remnants.

sit-in.definitionKo: 사람들이 어떤 목적을 이루기 위해 한곳에 자리를 잡고 시위함.
sit-in.englishDescription: A demonstration of a group of people in a place, to achieve a certain purpose.

slanted.englishDescription: A word describing the state of an object leaning slightly to one side.

slanted.definitionKo: 고개나 몸을 한쪽으로 조금 기울이는 모양.
slanted.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of tilting one's head or body slightly to one side.
Being slanted a little to one side.

slanted.definitionKo: 물체가 한 방향으로 조금 기울어져 있다.
slanted.englishDescription: An object slanting slightly into one direction.

slanted.definitionKo: 여럿이 모두 한 방향으로 조금 기울어져 있다.
slanted.englishDescription: Several things tilting slightly in the same direction.
A word describing the manner of an object leaning to one side slightly.
Being slanted in a very steep manner.

slanted.definitionKo: 모양이나 방향, 위치가 곧거나 바르지 않고 한쪽으로 기울거나 쏠린 상태에 있다.
slanted.englishDescription: A shape, direction, or position being not straight, but inclining or leaning to one side.

slanted.definitionKo: 몸이나 물체가 한쪽으로 비스듬하게 기울어져 있다.
slanted.englishDescription: A person's body or an object slightly leaning to one side.

slanted.definitionKo: 모양이나 방향, 위치가 곧거나 바르지 않고 한쪽으로 기울거나 쏠려 있다.
slanted.englishDescription: A shape, direction, or position being not straight, but inclining or leaning to one side.

slanted.definitionKo: 여러 물체가 한쪽으로 조금 기울어져 있다.
slanted.englishDescription: Several objects being slightly tilted to one side.

slanted.englishDescription: All of several things being slightly tilted to one side.

slayer.definitionKo: 손을 대어 직접 사람을 죽인 사람.
slayer.englishDescription: A person hired to kill another person.

sluggishly.englishDescription: In the manner of moving the body slowly and little by little.

sluggishly.definitionKo: 동작이 빠르지 못하고 매우 느린 모양.
sluggishly.englishDescription: A word describing the manner of moving very slowly.

sluggishly.definitionKo: 누웠거나 앉았다가 느리게 슬며시 일어나는 모양.
sluggishly.englishDescription: In the manner of standing up slowly and quietly from a lying or sitting position.

sluggishly.definitionKo: 몸집이 큰 사람이나 동물이 몸을 조금 흔들며 천천히 자꾸 걸어 다니는 모양.
sluggishly.englishDescription: In a manner of a big sized person or animal constantly walking around slowly while swaying his/her or its body from side to side.
In a manner of constantly moving slowly little by little.

sluggishly.definitionKo: 신발 등을 가볍게 끌며 걷는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
sluggishly.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when one walks, dragging one's shoes lightly, or such a motion.

sluggishly.definitionKo: 신발 등을 바닥에 끌며 걷는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
sluggishly.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when one walks, dragging one's shoes, or such a motion.

sluggishly.definitionKo: 몸을 계속 천천히 느리게 움직이는 모양.
sluggishly.englishDescription: A word describing the manner of continuously moving the body slowly.
In the manner of standing up slowly and quietly from a lying or sitting position.

socialize.definitionKo: 여러 사람과 자주 만나거나 어울려 지내다.
socialize.englishDescription: To meet and spend time with many people often.

socialize.definitionKo: 인간이 사회의 한 구성원으로 생활할 수 있도록 사회적인 성격을 가지게 되다. 또는 그런 성격을 가지게 하다.
socialize.englishDescription: For one to acquire a social nature so that he/she can live as a member of a society, or to make one have such a nature.

southwest.englishDescription: The direction between south and west.

The direction between the west and south.

spoon-feed.definitionKo: 수저 등으로 음식을 떠서 남에게 먹게 하다.
spoon-feed.englishDescription: To scoop up food with a spoon, etc., and feed it to someone.

ss.definitionKo: 한글 자모 ‘ㅅ’을 겹쳐서 쓴 글자. 이름은 '쌍시옷'으로, ‘ㅅ’의 된소리이다.
ss.englishDescription: The consonant in the Korean alphabet consisting of double 'siot', which is called double 'siot' and which creates a stronger sound than a single 'siot'.

state.englishDescription: (disparaging) A certain state or situation.
The look or situation of an object or phenomenon.
To express thoughts in words or writing.

state.definitionKo: 일정한 영토와 주권을 가지고 있는 사람들의 사회적인 조직.
state.englishDescription: A social organization of people with a territory and sovereign rights.

state.definitionKo: 어떤 주제에 대한 의견을 논리에 맞게 말하거나 적다.
state.englishDescription: To speak or write logically on a certain subject.

state.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 현상이 벌어지는 분위기나 되어가는 상태.
state.englishDescription: The state or atmosphere of an incident or phenomenon as it unfolds.
(slang) A situation or state in which things are shaping up.
To say something to express one's opinion.

state.definitionKo: 일이 되어 가는 상황이나 벌어진 일의 상태.
state.englishDescription: A progress or unfolding of a certain event, or a state of things that happened.

state.definitionKo: 일정한 땅과 거기에 사는 사람들로 구성되고, 주권에 의한 하나의 통치 조직을 이루는 집단.
state.englishDescription: An entity consisting of land and the people living there, resulting in a group ruled by sovereignty.

state.definitionKo: 어떤 형편이나 상태, 또는 일이 돌아가는 상황.
state.englishDescription: A situation or condition, or the state of an affair.

state.definitionKo: 어떤 사실, 사건, 생각 등을 논리나 순서에 따라 말하거나 적다.
state.englishDescription: To write or say a fact, incident, thought, etc., according to a certain logic or order.
To talk about a certain matter or problem.
A certain form or state.

state.definitionKo: 의견이나 감정 등을 겉으로 드러내 보이다.
state.englishDescription: To show one's opinion, feeling, etc., outwardly.
The situation and state of a particular affair.

state.definitionKo: 일이나 상황에 대해 의견을 자세히 이야기하다.
state.englishDescription: To give one's opinion on a certain topic or situation in a detailed manner.
One's situation or state.
The situation or circumstances under which a certain event takes place.
The progress or unfolding of a certain event.
To clearly show one's thought or attitude.

stir-fry.definitionKo: 물기를 거의 뺀 음식을 불 위에 놓고 이리저리 저으면서 익히다.
stir-fry.englishDescription: To drain most of water from ingredients, put them in a frying pan, and cook them over heat while stirring continuously.

strand.definitionKo: 하나에서 둘 이상으로 갈라져 나간 부분이나 가닥.
strand.englishDescription: Two or more parts or strands that branch off from a single one.

strand.definitionKo: 하나에서 둘 이상으로 갈라져 나간 부분이나 가닥을 세는 단위.
strand.englishDescription: A unit used to count the part, section, strand, branch, fork, etc., of something.

strand.definitionKo: 하나의 덩어리나 묶음에서 풀리거나 갈라져 나온 긴 줄.
strand.englishDescription: A long string or stem loosened or sprung out from a mass or bundle.
The unit for counting strings or stems.

strand.definitionKo: 실이나 국수 등 가늘고 긴 것의 가락.

strawboard.definitionKo: 어두운 노란빛이 나는, 질이 안 좋은 종이.

stunt.englishDescription: To do disservice by blocking and hindering something.

sublime.englishDescription: One's ideal being high and great.

sublime.englishDescription: So majestic and valuable that it cannot be treated disrespectfully.

sublime.definitionKo: 고체가 액체가 되는 일 없이 곧바로 기체로 변하다. 또는 기체가 곧바로 고체로 변하다.
sublime.englishDescription: For a solid to directly change into a gas without passing through a liquid phase; for a gas to change into a solid directly.

sublime.definitionKo: 뜻이나 이상 등이 더할 수 없이 높다.
sublime.englishDescription: A will, ideal, etc., being ultimately high.

substation.definitionKo: 발전소에서 보내오는 높은 전류를 가정이나 공장이 사용할 수 있는 전류로 바꾸어 내보내는 곳.
substation.englishDescription: A place where high-voltage electricity from a power plant is converted into electricity that can be used in homes or in factories before being distributed to them.

surrogate.definitionKo: 아기를 가질 수 없는 부부를 위해 돈을 받고 아기를 대신 낳아 주는 여자.
surrogate.englishDescription: A woman who gives birth to a baby for a sterile couple who pays for the surrogacy.

suturing.definitionKo: 상처의 갈라진 부분이나 수술을 하려고 벤 자리를 바늘로 꿰매어 붙이는 일.
suturing.englishDescription: The act of sewing to join the open parts of a wound or the incised parts for surgery together.

ta.definitionKo: 물건 열두 개를 한 묶음으로 세는 단위.
ta.englishDescription: dozen: A bound noun that serves as a unit of counting things by twelve.

tag.definitionKo: 우표나 상표 등과 같이 특별한 그림이나 글자를 넣은 작은 종이.

tag.definitionKo: 어떤 사물의 이름, 성분, 특징 등을 표시해 놓은 종이나 나무 등의 작은 조각.
tag.englishDescription: A small piece of paper or small wood piece on which the name, ingredients, characteristics, etc., of a certain object are indicated.

takings.definitionKo: 일정 기간 동안 상품 등을 팔아서 번 돈.
takings.englishDescription: Money earned by selling goods for a certain period of time.

takings.definitionKo: 상품을 판 금액. 또는 그 돈 전체의 액수.
takings.englishDescription: An amount of money earned by selling a product or the total amount of such money.

this.definitionKo: 말하는 사람에게 가까운 곳을 가리키는 말.
this.englishDescription: A pronoun used to indicate a place close to the speaker.

this.definitionKo: 상태, 모양, 성질 등이 이러한.
this.englishDescription: A state, shape, nature, etc., being like this.

this.definitionKo: 말하는 사람에게 가까이 있거나 말하는 사람이 생각하고 있는 대상을 가리키는 말.
this.englishDescription: A pronoun used to indicate something near the speaker or what the speaker is thinking.

this.definitionKo: 바로 앞에서 이야기한 대상을 가리키는 말.
this.englishDescription: A pronoun referring to something mentioned in the immediately preceding sentence.

this.definitionKo: ‘이 사람’을 가리키는 말.
this.englishDescription: A pronoun referring to "this person."

this.definitionKo: 바로 앞에서 이야기한 대상을 가리키는 말.
this.englishDescription: A word that refers to something which was just mentioned.

this.definitionKo: (귀엽게 이르는 말로) 이 아이.
this.englishDescription: (endearing) This kid.

this.englishDescription: A word used to indicate that something said is directly related to the speaker.

this.definitionKo: 듣는 사람에게 가까이 있거나 듣는 사람이 생각하고 있는 것을 가리키는 말.

thriving.englishDescription: Being strong, influential, active, and thriving.
A state in which one's force grows and prevails.
Splendid and active in commercial activities.
Trees or grass having grown thick.

thriving.definitionKo: 기운차게 일어나거나 세력이 대단히 커져서 널리 퍼짐.
thriving.englishDescription: The state of a group, country, etc., rising strongly or becoming powerful, with widening influence.

tilefish.definitionKo: 몸이 길고 납작하며 붉은색을 띤 바닷물고기.
tilefish.englishDescription: A saltwater fish with a long, flat body and a red color.

tinderbox.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 일이나 사건을 일으키게 되는 원인.
tinderbox.englishDescription: (figurative) A cause of a certain thing or event.

tinderbox.definitionKo: 한 번 건드리기만 해도 즉시 폭발할 것처럼 몹시 위급한 상황.
tinderbox.englishDescription: A very urgent situation in which something is likely to blow up even at the slightest touch.

tip.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 대해 상대방이 알 수 있도록 미리 슬그머니 말해 줌.
tip.englishDescription: The act of having another person know about something by tipping him/her beforehand.

tip.definitionKo: 긴 물건의 끝에 박힌 뾰족한 것.
tip.englishDescription: A sharp part inserted at the end of a long object.

tip.definitionKo: 호텔이나 식당 등에서, 시중을 드는 사람에게 고맙다는 뜻으로 요금 외에 더 주는 돈.
tip.englishDescription: In a hotel, restaurant, etc., extra money given to an attending person as a way to express gratitude, in addition to the fixed price, rate, etc.

tip.definitionKo: 바둑이나 장기 등을 둘 때 구경하던 사람이 끼어들어 수를 가르쳐 줌.
tip.englishDescription: In playing go or janggi, Korean chess, etc., a state in which a non-participant intervenes and teaches a player what to do with a move.

tip.definitionKo: 남의 일에 끼어들어 이래라저래라 참견하는 말.
tip.englishDescription: Words uttered when one intervenes in another's affairs and tells him/her what to do.

tip.definitionKo: 남의 일에 끼어들어 이래라저래라 참견하는 말을 하다.
tip.englishDescription: To intervene in another's affair and tell him/her what to do.

tip.englishDescription: In playing go or Chinese chess, etc., for a non-participant to intervene and teach a player what to do with a move.

tip.definitionKo: 문제를 풀거나 일을 해결하는 데 도움이 되는 것.
tip.englishDescription: Something that helps solve a problem or resolve an issue.

totality.englishDescription: A certain object's characteristic of being whole.

transience.definitionKo: 시간이 가면서 모든 것이 변하므로 가치나 의미가 없어 허무함.
transience.englishDescription: Futility with lack of meaning or value because everything changes as time passes by.

tread.englishDescription: To take a step forward in the direction of a destination.

tread.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 분야의 일을 계속해 나가거나, 운명적으로 주어진 과정을 거쳐 나가다.
tread.englishDescription: (figurative) For someone to continue to work in a certain field or go through a certain process destined for him/her.
(figurative) To follow a certain path or evolve.

tread.definitionKo: 어떤 대상에 발을 올려놓고 서거나 올려놓으면서 걷다.
tread.englishDescription: To put feet on an object and stand on it or to tread on it.

trifle.definitionKo: 아주 작은 티끌이나 먼지. 또는 작고 변변치 못한 물건.
trifle.englishDescription: A mote or a speck of dust; a small, worthless object.

tumbler.definitionKo: 손잡이가 없고 바닥이 납작한 큰 잔.
tumbler.englishDescription: A large cup without a handle and with a flat bottom.

tyranny.definitionKo: 특정한 개인이나 집단이 모든 권력을 차지하고 마음대로 일을 처리함.
tyranny.englishDescription: A state in which a certain individual or group exercises absolute power and handles everything in his/her or its own way.

tyranny.definitionKo: 한 나라의 권력을 한 사람이 모두 차지하고 자기 마음대로 하는 정치.
tyranny.englishDescription: A form of politics in which a single person exercises absolute power and handles everything in his/her own way in a country.
An extremely heartless and cruel rule by a king, government, etc.
An extremely heartless and cruel rule by a king, government, etc.
The state of one’s personality or behavior being very cruel and fierce.
A state of acting as one pleases and being extremely violent.

ulsan.definitionKo: 경상남도 동북쪽에 있는 광역시. 국내 최대의 공업 도시로 조선, 자동차 등의 중화학 공업이 발달하였다.
ulsan.englishDescription: A metropolitan city in the northeastern region of Gyeongsangnam-do, or South Gyeongsang Province; It is Korea's biggest industrial city particularly famous for its heavy industry such as the automobile industry.

unawareness.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 일에 대해 전혀 모르는 상태.
unawareness.englishDescription: (figurative) A state of having no knowledge about a certain event.

uninteresting.definitionKo: 잘 어울리지 않고 재미가 없는 데가 있다.
uninteresting.englishDescription: Being unfitting and lacking something interesting.

uninteresting.definitionKo: 일거리가 없거나 생기는 일이 없어 심심하고 어색하다.
uninteresting.englishDescription: Boring and awkward as there is nothing to do or nothing happens.

universality.definitionKo: 모든 것에 두루 미치거나 통하는 성질.
universality.englishDescription: A quality that is commonly applied or pervasively understood.

universality.definitionKo: 일부가 아닌 전체에 두루 해당되는 것.
universality.englishDescription: The quality of being applicable to the whole, not a part.

valuation.englishDescription: The act of judging the value of an object subjectively.

veneer.definitionKo: 얇고 판판하게 자른 나뭇조각을 여러 겹 붙여 만든 판.
veneer.englishDescription: A board made by gluing thin, flat pieces of wood together in several layers.

vent.definitionKo: 안에서 만들어진 것을 밖으로 밀어 내보내는 구멍이나 통로.
vent.englishDescription: A hole or passage in a container through which something made inside is let out.

vent.definitionKo: 쌓였던 감정이 한꺼번에 터져 나오는 곳. 또는 쌓였던 감정을 터뜨리기 위한 수단.
vent.englishDescription: An opening through which a person's pent up emotions surge out all at once, or a means for venting his/her pent up emotions.

vent.englishDescription: To suddenly express a bad feeling about someone or something to someone or in front of others.

vomit.definitionKo: 삼킨 것을 입 밖으로 도로 내놓다.

To throw up what one ate.

vomit.definitionKo: 먹은 것을 도로 입 밖으로 쏟아 내다.
vomit.englishDescription: To let something one has eaten come out of one's  mouth.

which.definitionKo: 주어진 여러 사람이나 사물 중에서 대상으로 삼는 것이 무엇인지 물을 때 쓰는 말.
which.englishDescription: A word used when asking what is being chosen among several given people or things.

whooppee.definitionKo: 뜻밖에 기쁜 일이 생겼을 때 내는 소리.
whooppee.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when something pleasant happens unexpectedly.

wide-eyed.englishDescription: A person's eyes being sunken and round.

wide-eyed.englishDescription: Wide-open eyes being large and round, being frightened or scared by something.

windingly.englishDescription: In a shape that twists and curves in places.

windingly.englishDescription: In the state of being tilted or bent in places, not straight.

with.englishDescription: A postpositional particle to indicate that the preceding statement is the subject of comparison.

with.englishDescription: A postpositional particle to indicate that the preceding statement is the subject that is influenced by a certain action, emotion, etc.

wizard.definitionKo: 초자연적인 능력이 있어 신기한 일을 하는 기술을 가진 사람.
wizard.englishDescription: A person who has supernatural powers and is skilled at amazing people.

woodblock.definitionKo: 인쇄를 하기 위해서 글이나 그림을 새긴 나무 판.
woodblock.englishDescription: A block of wood where texts or images are carved for printing.

worshiper.definitionKo: 신이나 부처 등의 종교적 대상을 우러러 믿고 따르는 사람.
worshiper.englishDescription: A person who follows and believes in a religious subject such as a god, Buddha, etc.

yearn.definitionKo: 어떤 대상을 마음속으로 간절히 그리워하고 바라다.
yearn.englishDescription: To miss and earnestly desire something with all one's heart.
